fact_checks.current_value: Adults seizure disorders: 1.5 mg/day initial; titrate to effect; maximum 20 mg/day; maintenance often 1.5-20 mg/day divided TID

summary: Clonazepam row mostly matches FDA labeling for identity, U.S. availability, formulation, mechanism, metabolism, half-life, labeled seizure indications, and adult seizure dosing maximum. Updates are needed for the DailyMed black-box source, overbroad epilepsy wording, enzyme-effect wording, unsupported 7% salivation frequency, untrusted evidence_sources, and misleading RCT notes/links. The two PubMed links do not support clonazepam-vs-placebo RR50/MPC/seizure-freedom outcomes; the current NR outcome fields are therefore appropriate.
